content:
iPhone Duo is launching soon. If you want to get your hands on accessories for Apple's new phone ahead of time, here are our top picks.

Apple Pencil: For handwritten notes, sketching and more

The iPhone Duo will be the first iPhone to support the Apple Pencil, allowing you to jot down notes or doodle on the go.

Apple Pencil support will be added to the iPhone Duo via a software update later. However, Apple says you'll need to use the Apple Pencil (USB-C)—no other Pencil models are compatible.

The iPhone Duo works with Apple Pencil on both the outer and inner displays. The design of Apple's first foldable was actually inspired by the proportions of a standard A-series notebook.

  • Apple Pencil (USB-C): Now $69 (was $79)

Charger: For fast charging the iPhone Duo

The iPhone Duo supports fast charging, getting you to 50% in just 20 minutes.

But to get the fastest charging speeds, you'll need a compatible charger.

Apple's 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max supports fast charging for the iPhone Duo. If you're looking for a third-party alternative, Anker's 100W charger is also a solid choice.

Like other models, the iPhone Duo doesn't come with a charger in the box—just a USB-C cable. Many people probably already have a 20W charger at home, but if you want the fastest charging speeds for your iPhone Duo, these two products are my recommendations.

  • Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max: Now $34 (was $39)
  • Anker 100W USB-C Charger with 5FT Cable: $29

MagSafe car mount: Handy for when you're out and about

One of the iPhone accessories I've always recommended is ESR's MagSafe car mount. I've been using one for years, and I'm sure it'll work just as well with the iPhone Duo.

With a MagSafe car mount, your iPhone has a secure spot whenever you're on the go. The MagSafe magnets are strong enough to attach the mount to your air conditioning vent, keeping it in plain sight and within easy reach when you need it.

When I'm driving, I like using my iPhone with CarPlay so I can see Apple Maps navigation on the CarPlay display while my iPhone shows the full step-by-step directions. With the iPhone Duo's larger screen, I expect the experience to be even better.

  • ESR MagSafe car mount: Now $19 (was $29)

iPhone Duo cases

Apple hasn't started selling the $129 iPhone Duo Folio with Kickstand just yet. But if you're looking for a much more affordable iPhone Duo case, there are already plenty of third-party options available.

Picking up an iPhone Duo case not only helps you get ready for October 23, but also gives you a preview of the iPhone Duo's size and shape—without having to shell out $1,999 or more first.

I haven't tried the cases below myself, but they're the ones I'm interested in.

  • SPIDERCASE Magnetic Case: Built-in stand and screen protector, $39
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid Pro: Clear case with MagSafe support, $34

Home cameras: For use with the iPhone Duo StandBy mode

The iPhone Duo will significantly upgrade the existing iPhone StandBy feature. When the iPhone Duo is in "stand" mode, it can display various StandBy screens even without being plugged in.

StandBy options include "Home Camera" and "Home Modular" screens, both of which can connect to smart home accessories.

The Home Camera view is especially handy for keeping an eye on all your home security cameras at a glance. Here are some HomeKit-compatible cameras I recommend.

  • Aqara G100 2K Security Camera: A great value pick at just $39
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: If you want 4K quality, this one isn't too pricey at $59

Which iPhone Duo accessories are you planning to get? Let us know in the comments.

Best iPhone accessory recommendations

  • 10-Year Battery AirTag Protective Case
  • AirTag 2 (Now $24, was $29)
  • iPhone MagSafe car mount
  • 100W USB-C fast charger
  • HomeKit garage door opener
